STAFATORRENTNETWORK

> INTERACTIVE NOISE WEB GENERATOR
// HOW TO PLAY
①
Click SOUND ON at the bottom-right of the dark area to activate audio.
②
Press & hold anywhere on the dark hero area to produce sound.
③
Drag while pressing to modulate.
④
Left–right = pitch & filter. Up–down = distortion & reverb.
⑤
Choose sound mode (DRONE / NOISE / GLITCH / FM) from the bottom-left buttons.
⑥
Scroll down to read the portfolio.
// SOUND MODES
DRONE sawtooth+square
NOISE white noise
GLITCH square+LFO
FM FM synthesis
